title: BIRD-Persona: A Persona-Aware Benchmark for SQL and pandas Analytics Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production text-to-code systems use large language models to turn natural-language analytics requests into executable SQL and pandas code. Existing benchmarks cover both tasks but do not isolate when performance diverges between them. We introduce BIRD-Persona, a persona-stratified extension of BIRD-Python that adds novice and expert rewrites to tasks with matched SQL and pandas ground truth, along with schema variants and task-structure annotations. Across 1,534 tasks, nine models, and 245,592 evaluations, SQL outperforms pandas for eight of nine systems. The gap varies by condition: expert, schema-explicit prompts improve both paradigms but help SQL more; schema representations have mixed, model-dependent effects; and selected-column burden widens the gap while subqueries do not. By making user phrasing a controlled benchmark dimension, BIRD-Persona supports persona-aware and paradigm-aware evaluation of natural-language analytics syst

translated_title: BIRD-Persona：一个面向SQL和pandas分析代码生成的角色感知基准
translated_abstract: 生产级文本到代码系统使用大语言模型将自然语言分析请求转换为可执行的SQL和pandas代码。现有基准测试同时涵盖这两类任务，但未能隔离出两者之间性能出现分歧的具体条件。我们提出BIRD-Persona，这是BIRD-Python的一个按用户角色分层的扩展版本，它为具有匹配SQL和pandas标准答案的任务添加了新手和专家风格的改写，同时包含模式变体和任务结构标注。在1,534个任务、九个模型和245,592次评估中，SQL在九个系统中的八个上优于pandas。性能差距因条件而异：专家式、模式显式的提示词对两种范式都有提升，但对SQL的帮助更大；模式表示的影响不一且依赖于具体模型；选定列的负担会扩大差距，而子查询则不会。通过将用户措辞作为受控的基准测试维度，BIRD-Persona支持对自然语言分析系统进行角色感知和范式感知的评估。
tldr: BIRD-Persona是一个通过引入新手/专家角色改写、模式变体和任务结构标注构建的角色感知代码生成基准，大规模实验表明SQL在绝大多数大语言模型上优于pandas，且两者差距随用户措辞、模式表示和任务结构等因素系统性变化。
